  match Proc.args () with
  | [dir, n] ->
    let keep =
      if Regex.match? r/^[0-9]+$/ n then
        match Int.of_string n with
        | Ok k -> k
        | Error _ -> usage! "bad N"
      else usage! "N must be a whole number of 0 or more"

        |> List.filter (fn s -> FS.file? (Path.join d (Path.of_string s)))
        |> List.sort

      let dropn = if total > keep then total - keep else 0
      let gone = List.take dropn names
      List.each (fn s -> FS.delete! (Path.join d (Path.of_string s))) gone
      List.each (fn s -> IO.println "deleted %{s}") gone
